If the medical need is genuine, the judge's strict order still allows the life-saving transplant to proceed before prison time begins.
Plane Error: WHY vs HOW. The claim uses maternal health (WHY) as an absolute moral shield, but procedural delays (HOW) reveal a strategy of pushing back prison surrender dates.

Social Physics Analysis:
Using family medical emergencies as post-hoc pretexts creates high systemic friction. When legitimate compassion is leveraged to delay accountability, courts must enforce rigid boundaries to preserve rule of law.

The Trajectory: The Path of Fall into Deception.
When narrative claims of urgent medical sacrifice clash with repeated procedural postponements, the coordinate collapses into direct judicial reckoning.

The Unavoidable Truth: A court cannot allow medical reprieves to turn into indefinite immunity from sentencing.

The Unavoidable Lie: The delay was purely an unexpected coincidence unrelated to avoiding a prison surrender date.
